extracted text: The paper studies precipitation hardening of A356 Al alloy produced by gas induced semi-solid (GISS) process. The alloy underwent T6 heat treatment with solution treatment at 540°C for 4h followed by water quenching at room temperature. Aging was performed at different temperatures (165°C, 195°C, and 225°C) and times. The optimum aging condition was found to be 165°C for 18h. The mechanical properties for different conditions are reported, including as-cast and aged specimens. Fine β″ needle-like precipitates were mainly responsible for peak aged strengthening of the alloy.
